The dual concealer pen

Conceal. Set. Go.

A hydrating liquid concealer on one end and a self-dispensing setting powder brush on the other. One slim pen, two steps, no extra tools.

Two ends.
One routine.

1

Twist and glide

Twist the collar to release concealer onto the cool metal tip, then glide it under the eyes. The cool touch helps tired eyes look refreshed.

2

Flip and set

Flip the pen and click to release loose powder into the soft, short, angled brush. Sweep it over the concealer to lock it in place.
